_comment: Port allocation scheme per ADR 0014. Internal ports are Docker overlay only (no host mapping). Host ports are published to the Docker host. The gateway_host_ports range (20100-39900) is consumed by 1Install.ps1 for the Windows Firewall rule. Retired ports are never reassigned ÔÇö see ADR 0014 ┬º4. Gateway keys are lowercase role codes (base, orch, veri, work) matching Get-AgentHostPort's .ToLower() lookup ÔÇö each role gets a non-overlapping /24 block (base=20300, orch=20400, veri=20500, work=20600) with max 9 instances per role.
